quotes.name: Amara Keane
quotes.quote: I've noticed more empty storefronts along Lakeshore lately, and it does make the neighborhood feel a bit quieter than it used to. I hope we can find ways to support local businesses and keep the area vibrant.

quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I've noticed more empty storefronts around Grand Lake lately—it's tough to see. As a baker, I know how much foot traffic matters, and when shops sit vacant, it hurts everyone.

quotes.name: Rick Walker
quotes.quote: I don't spend much time over in Grand Lake, but I've heard folks at work talking about how stores are struggling to stay open. Makes me worry about the neighborhood losing its character.
